title: Raiding for Immortal Jade
summary: In the Soul Refining Sect's forbidden area, the dying Dun Tian passes the sect to Wang Lin in front of the spirit tablets of its Soul Transformation ancestors. In return Wang Lin must guard the Billion Soul Flag and one day raise the sect into a level 6 cultivation country. Since the sect has only a third of the immortal jade Wang Lin needs for Soul Transformation, Dun Tian takes him to rob other sects, starting with Yan Hong and Sha Zi of the Wild Demon Sect, and teaches him that immortal jade can only be taken by force. On the way back they meet the Forsaken Immortal Clan's Fifth Ancestor Cui Zhi, a nine-leaf shaman. Dun Tian shows Wang Lin the flag's true power, rising to mid Ascendant strength, and sends Cui Zhi away. He tells Wang Lin that the Fourth Main Soul in the flag, the sect's last Ascendant ancestor, fell beside the second Suzaku, whom Wang Lin suspects is Situ Nan. At Suzaku Country's great Suzaku Mystic Formation, Dun Tian forces Qian Feng to let them through, and Qian Feng challenges Wang Lin to a duel.
events: Dun Tian hands Wang Lin the Soul Refining Sect and the duty to guard the Billion Soul Flag
Dun Tian and Wang Lin rob the Wild Demon Sect of half its immortal jade
Wang Lin remembers Tian Yunzi's invitation to Planet Tian Yun
Cui Zhi, a nine-leaf shaman, attacks them; Dun Tian shows the flag's full power and drives him off
Dun Tian tells of the Fourth Main Soul and the second Suzaku; Wang Lin suspects Situ Nan
Dun Tian finds Giant Demon blood in the Suzaku Mystic Formation and makes Qian Feng open it
cultivation: Yan Hong and Sha Zi: early Soul Transformation. Cui Zhi, a nine-leaf shaman, is equal to early Ascendant. Using the flag, Dun Tian reaches mid Ascendant power. Dun Tian says Wang Lin's immortal-energy fusion is at great perfection and his body has reached the Crystal Bone stage.
